title: Benchmarking Multimodal Models for Ukrainian Language Understanding Across Academic and Cultural Domains

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal models on a custom Ukrainian cuisine benchmark (UACUISINE) to detect cultural misattribution, such as mislabeling traditional Ukrainian dishes as Russian or generating non-traditional/Russian recipes instead of authentic Ukrainian ones.

Comparing model performance on original English VQA datasets versus translated Ukrainian versions to measure performance degradation, and analyzing models' tendency to code-switch into higher-resource languages (like English, Russian, or Chinese) when prompted in Ukrainian.
